name: Bataguassu (Brazil)
description: Divided vertically white and green in the proportions 1:2, the green bearing a narrow red stripe edged in white through the centre, the white charged with the municipal arms.
history: Bataguassu is a municipality in the state of Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil. Portuguese Wikipedia records that the flag, like the arms, was designed by Professor Arcinoé Antonio Peixoto de Faria: the arms represent the municipal government, the white rectangle the town itself and the central stripe the radiation of municipal power.

features.role: narrow red stripe edged in white
